payload.task_text:
I need an enrollment overview for all courses from the Fall 2013 semester to prepare for an upcoming academic review meeting.

Please look up all courses that ran in the Fall of 2013, get their enrollment numbers broken down by student and teacher counts, and create a Google Sheet called Fall 2013 Enrollment Overview. The sheet should have columns Course_Name, Course_Code, Student_Count, and Teacher_Count, sorted by Student_Count descending. Student_Count is the number of students currently enrolled in the course, and Teacher_Count is the number of teachers enrolled. Every total enrollment figure in the presentation, Word document, and email (such as "total student enrollment" or "total students enrolled") must count student enrollments only — do not include teachers or teaching assistants in any total.

Then create a PowerPoint presentation called Enrollment_Overview_F2013.pptx for the academic review meeting. The presentation should have a title slide called Fall 2013 Enrollment Overview, one content slide per course showing the course name, course code, and its enrollment breakdown, and a final summary slide showing the total student enrollment across all courses and which course had the largest enrollment.

Create a Word document called Enrollment_Report_F2013.docx with a heading that reads Fall 2013 Enrollment Report, a paragraph summarizing the total student enrollment and the number of courses offered that semester, and a table listing each course with its course code, student count, and teacher count.

Send an email to academic.office@university.edu with the subject Fall 2013 Semester Enrollment Summary. The email body should include the key enrollment statistics such as total students enrolled, number of courses, and which course had the most students.

Task-Solving Rationable with Sub-task Decomposition:
To solve this task efficiently, the main agent first gathers the compact counts and freezes one literal payload, then parallelizes the three independent report writers.

Call canvas_list_courses(include_ended=true), retain exactly the courses whose full name contains Fall 2013 or whose code ends in 2013J, and freeze their literal IDs/codes/names. In one native-parallel response issue, for every retained course, canvas_get_course_grades(page=1, per_page=1, type=["StudentEnrollment"]) and canvas_get_course_grades(page=1, per_page=1, type=["TeacherEnrollment"]). Use pagination.total_count only; never fetch enrollment rows. Validate identity and exactly-once course coverage. Compute and freeze a canonical table {course_name, course_code, student_count, teacher_count}, sorted by student_count descending with course_code ascending for ties, plus total_students, course_count, and the deterministic largest-student course. All writers and the email must consume these literal values without recomputation.

1. Wave 1 — dispatch exactly 3 coder sub-agents in parallel:

   1. coder 0 (external-workflow-operator 0): The first Coder is the sole owner of the Google spreadsheet titled Fall 2013 Enrollment Overview. Create or reuse one exact-title spreadsheet, write only the requested Course_Name, Course_Code, Student_Count, Teacher_Count table to a precisely bounded range beginning A1, and read that exact range back. Do not add diagnostic cells or write the local files.
   2. coder 1 (office-report-builder 0): The second Coder is the sole writer of Enrollment_Overview_F2013.pptx in the task's dynamically resolved workspace. From the canonical payload create one title slide, one slide per literal course, and one final summary slide with total student enrollment and the largest course; read back slide count, titles, and values.
   3. coder 2 (office-report-builder 1): The third Coder is the sole writer of Enrollment_Report_F2013.docx in the same resolved workspace. Create the exact heading, summary paragraph, and complete course table from the canonical payload, then read the document back.

In the same response that launches Wave 1, the main agent independently searches Sent mail for academic.office@university.edu with subject Fall 2013 Semester Enrollment Summary. Read candidates to verify the recipient; send once only if absent, using the canonical student-only total, course count, and largest course. After Wave 1, read/reconcile the spreadsheet, presentation, document, and retained email against the same payload. Do not create a verification wave.

nodes.text:
You are creating a Google Sheet for an academic enrollment overview. Use ONLY the mcp__google_sheet__* tools (create_spreadsheet, update_cells, rename_sheet, list_sheets, get_sheet_data).

GOAL: Create a Google Spreadsheet titled exactly "Fall 2013 Enrollment Overview" with columns Course_Name, Course_Code, Student_Count, Teacher_Count, sorted by Student_Count descending.

DATA (already gathered from Canvas — use exactly these numbers, they are verified):
1. Course_Name: "Foundations of Finance (Fall 2013)", Course_Code: "FFF-2013J", Student_Count: 2283, Teacher_Count: 1
2. Course_Name: "Biochemistry & Bioinformatics (Fall 2013)", Course_Code: "BBB-2013J", Student_Count: 2237, Teacher_Count: 3
3. Course_Name: "Data-Driven Design (Fall 2013)", Course_Code: "DDD-2013J", Student_Count: 1938, Teacher_Count: 1
4. Course_Name: "Environmental Economics & Ethics (Fall 2013)", Course_Code: "EEE-2013J", Student_Count: 1052, Teacher_Count: 1
5. Course_Name: "Global Governance & Geopolitics (Fall 2013)", Course_Code: "GGG-2013J", Student_Count: 952, Teacher_Count: 2
6. Course_Name: "Applied Analytics & Algorithms (Fall 2013)", Course_Code: "AAA-2013J", Student_Count: 383, Teacher_Count: 1

STEPS:
1. Call mcp__google_sheet__create_spreadsheet with title "Fall 2013 Enrollment Overview". Note the returned spreadsheet_id.
2. Check what the default first sheet is called (mcp__google_sheet__list_sheets) — if it is not "Sheet1" or similar, rename it via rename_sheet to "Sheet1" OR simply write data to whatever sheet exists. Prefer keeping it simple: write into the existing default sheet.
3. Write the header row and 6 data rows (in the order above, already sorted by Student_Count descending) into cells A1:D7 using mcp__google_sheet__update_cells: range "A1:D7", data as 2D array:
   [["Course_Name","Course_Code","Student_Count","Teacher_Count"],
    ["Foundations of Finance (Fall 2013)","FFF-2013J",2283,1],
    ["Biochemistry & Bioinformatics (Fall 2013)","BBB-2013J",2237,3],
    ["Data-Driven Design (Fall 2013)","DDD-2013J",1938,1],
    ["Environmental Economics & Ethics (Fall 2013)","EEE-2013J",1052,1],
    ["Global Governance & Geopolitics (Fall 2013)","GGG-2013J",952,2],
    ["Applied Analytics & Algorithms (Fall 2013)","AAA-2013J",383,1]]
4. Verify by reading back the data (mcp__google_sheet__get_sheet_data with range "A1:D7") and confirm all 7 rows are present and correct.

RETURN: the spreadsheet_id, the spreadsheet title, and a confirmation of the final content (all rows) in your final report.
Create Google Sheet enrollment overview

You are creating a PowerPoint presentation for an academic review meeting. Use ONLY the mcp__pptx__* tools (create_presentation, add_slide, populate_placeholder, add_bullet_points, add_table, manage_text, extract_presentation_text, save_presentation).

GOAL: Create a presentation and save it to the absolute path:
/workspace/dumps/kimi-code_deepseek-v4-flash/SingleUserTurn-canvas-enrollment-overview-gsheet-ppt/workspace/Enrollment_Overview_F2013.pptx

Presentation title: "Fall 2013 Enrollment Overview"

DATA (already gathered from Canvas — verified numbers, use exactly these):
Courses (course name as shown, course code, student count, teacher count):
1. Foundations of Finance (Fall 2013) — FFF-2013J — 2283 students — 1 teacher
2. Biochemistry & Bioinformatics (Fall 2013) — BBB-2013J — 2237 students — 3 teachers
3. Data-Driven Design (Fall 2013) — DDD-2013J — 1938 students — 1 teacher
4. Environmental Economics & Ethics (Fall 2013) — EEE-2013J — 1052 students — 1 teacher
5. Global Governance & Geopolitics (Fall 2013) — GGG-2013J — 952 students — 2 teachers
6. Applied Analytics & Algorithms (Fall 2013) — AAA-2013J — 383 students — 1 teacher

SUMMARY STATS (for the final summary slide):
- Total student enrollment across all 6 courses: 8845 (students only — do NOT add teachers into this total)
- Number of courses: 6
- Course with the largest enrollment: Foundations of Finance (Fall 2013) with 2283 students

STEPS:
1. mcp__pptx__create_presentation (no id needed).
2. Slide 0 — TITLE SLIDE: add_slide with title "Fall 2013 Enrollment Overview" (you may use add_slide with title parameter, layout_index 0 for title layout if available). Populate the title/subtitle placeholders via populate_placeholder (placeholder_idx 0 = title, 1 = subtitle) — subtitle could be "Academic Review Meeting" or "Open University — Fall 2013". Ensure the title text reads exactly "Fall 2013 Enrollment Overview".
3. Slides 1–6 — ONE CONTENT SLIDE PER COURSE (in the order listed above). For each course, add a slide (add_slide with title = course name, e.g., "Foundations of Finance (Fall 2013)") and then populate the body: either via populate_placeholder (placeholder_idx 1) with text like "Course Code: FFF-2013J\nStudents Enrolled: 2283\nTeachers: 1", or use add_bullet_points on placeholder_idx 1 with a list ["Course Code: FFF-2013J", "Students Enrolled: 2283", "Teachers: 1"]. Each course slide must show the course name (title), the course code, and the student/teacher breakdown.
4. Slide 7 — SUMMARY SLIDE: add_slide with title "Summary" (or "Fall 2013 Summary"). Body should include: "Total Student Enrollment: 8845", "Number of Courses: 6", "Largest Course: Foundations of Finance (Fall 2013) — 2283 students". Use bullet points.
5. Verify: mcp__pptx__extract_presentation_text to confirm all slides contain the correct content (title slide, 6 course slides, summary slide).
6. mcp__pptx__save_presentation with file_path = /workspace/dumps/kimi-code_deepseek-v4-flash/SingleUserTurn-canvas-enrollment-overview-gsheet-ppt/workspace/Enrollment_Overview_F2013.pptx

RETURN: the saved file path, total number of slides, and a brief confirmation of what each slide contains.
Create enrollment overview PPTX

You are creating a Word document report. Use ONLY the mcp__word__* tools (create_document, add_heading, add_paragraph, add_table, get_document_text, get_document_outline).

GOAL: Create a Word document and save it to the absolute path:
/workspace/dumps/kimi-code_deepseek-v4-flash/SingleUserTurn-canvas-enrollment-overview-gsheet-ppt/workspace/Enrollment_Report_F2013.docx

CONTENT REQUIREMENTS:
1. A heading that reads exactly: "Fall 2013 Enrollment Report" (use add_heading with level 1).
2. A paragraph summarizing the total student enrollment and the number of courses offered that semester. Use these verified facts: Total student enrollment = 8845 students (students only — do not include teachers in this total). Number of courses = 6. Example paragraph: "During the Fall 2013 semester, a total of 8,845 students were enrolled across 6 courses offered by the university." Feel free to phrase naturally but keep the numbers exact.
3. A table listing each course with its course code, student count, and teacher count. Use add_table with header row: ["Course Code", "Student Count", "Teacher Count"] (the table should have 4 columns OR 3 columns — the required columns are course code, student count, teacher count; you may include the course name as an extra first column if desired, but the required data columns must be present). Recommended: 4 columns [Course Name, Course Code, Student Count, Teacher Count] with rows:
   - Foundations of Finance (Fall 2013) | FFF-2013J | 2283 | 1
   - Biochemistry & Bioinformatics (Fall 2013) | BBB-2013J | 2237 | 3
   - Data-Driven Design (Fall 2013) | DDD-2013J | 1938 | 1
   - Environmental Economics & Ethics (Fall 2013) | EEE-2013J | 1052 | 1
   - Global Governance & Geopolitics (Fall 2013) | GGG-2013J | 952 | 2
   - Applied Analytics & Algorithms (Fall 2013) | AAA-2013J | 383 | 1
   (If you use 3 columns, use Course Code | Student Count | Teacher Count and only include the code column. Either is acceptable as long as course code, student count, teacher count appear.)

STEPS:
1. mcp__word__create_document with filename = /workspace/dumps/kimi-code_deepseek-v4-flash/SingleUserTurn-canvas-enrollment-overview-gsheet-ppt/workspace/Enrollment_Report_F2013.docx (and optionally title/author).
2. mcp__word__add_heading for "Fall 2013 Enrollment Report" (level 1).
3. mcp__word__add_paragraph with the summary (total students 8845, 6 courses).
4. mcp__word__add_table with rows=7, cols=4 (header + 6 data rows) and pass the data as a 2D array of strings.
5. Verify with mcp__word__get_document_text and mcp__word__get_document_outline that the heading, paragraph, and table are present.

RETURN: the saved file path, the heading text, and confirmation of the paragraph content and table contents.
